subject.name: Solar thermal installers and technicians
subject.summary: On this page, installers and technicians refers to solar thermal installation and technical work: installing and repairing systems that collect, store and circulate solar-heated water, handling collectors, piping, storage tanks, pumps and controllers, checking function and handing over operation and maintenance records. The object is a hot water system; equipment models, construction requirements, professional testing and work authority are checked separately per project documents and location.
